title: Warm Roasted Jamaican Peas Hash
description: A warm, roasted, and chewy Jamaican dish featuring peas and a flavorful nimono-simmer, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: Dried Kidney Peas
ingredients.notes: any type of dried peas will do

instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the dried peas, Jamaican Jerk Seasoning, and a pinch of salt.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and chopped Scotch Bonnet pepper (if using) and cook for another minute.
Add the peas and jerk seasoning mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the peas are tender and lightly browned.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot.
